numerics.terminal_frame_guarantee: main.cc writes when timeLoop.finished() or transport.shouldStop()
numerics.stop: first accepted local salt mole fraction >= 0.1

execution.production_wall_limit: pending measured benchmark, then frozen before submission
execution.scratch_policy: compute-node local scratch; stage one field archive and one diagnostics archive to /WORK
execution.reason: the user file-count soft quota is already exceeded; avoid adding ~1200 VTU directory entries to /WORK

diagnostics.conservative: signed SCVF plane fluxes and inventories at the original seven planes
diagnostics.field_scope: VTK cell-centre velocity is qualitative only
diagnostics.known_limitation: the frozen executable does not separate local positive and negative SCVF contributions

scientific_scope: exploratory R24 evidence only; no convergence, crystallization-delay or t_eff claim
failure_policy: preserve failure products and stop; no restart or resubmission without new user authorization
